Name: MKNewMachines
Author: MirandaKusland
Description:
English is not my native language, so I apologize for any mistakes.

The mod adds new cars:

[b][i]Plant Bin[/i][/b] and [b][i]Elite Plant Bin[/i][/b] – produces fiber from mixed seeds, sometimes produces fiber seeds. Works everywhere. Recipe requires Foraging 2 and 4. Machines differ in the amount of resources they produce.

[b][i]Magic Wood[/i][/b] – works on the principle of Crystallarium. Produces wood and all types of wood syrups. Appearance depends on the season or location. Works everywhere. Recipe requires Foraging 7.

[b][i]Boer[/i][/b] – works on the principle of Crystallarium. Produces all types of ores, coal, stone, clay and geodes. The appearance depends on the extracted resource. Works only outdoors. Recipe requires Mining 3. After achieving perfection in Mining, he can mine stones and minerals, and attacks can be converted into Crystallarium and back. Transformation recipes can be purchased from Clint.

[b][i]Aquarium[/i][/b] – works on the principle of Crystallarium. Produces all types of algae, coral, jellies, bug flesh and fish. The quality of the fish depends on the source. The appearance depends on the resource being produced. Works everywhere. Recipe requires Fishing 6.

[b][i]Elite mushroom stump[/i][/b] – works on the principle of Crystallarium. Supports all types of vanilla mushrooms except truffles, as well as mushrooms from SVE and More Mushrooms for Stardew Valley. Compatible with all mushroom mods that have ContextTags mushroom_item.  The quality of mushrooms depends on the source. Appearance depends on the season or location. Works everywhere. Recipe requires Foraging 6. Once perfected in Foraging can produce truffles.

[b][i]Box Of Desires[/i][/b] – Produces Solar Essence, Void Essence, Bat Wing or Bone Piece once per day. Recipe requires Combat 4.

[b][i]Ripener[/i][/b]  and [b][i]Elite Ripener[/i][/b] – Improves the quality of plants, eggs, meat and milk. Recipe requires Farming 4 and 6. Machines differ in the amount of upgradeable resources.

[b][i]Water Ripener[/i][/b] and [b][i]Elite Water Ripener[/i][/b] - Improves the quality of fish, some algae, corals and shells. Recipe requires Fishing 4 and 6. Machines differ in the amount of upgradeable resources.

[b][i]For beginners[/i][/b]: if all the requirements for obtaining a recipe are met before installing the mod, then the recipe will be available immediately after installing the mod.

Additionally, truffles can now be dried. Supports drying of mushrooms from SVE.

If you don't want to use any machine, simply disable the settings in the configuration menu. After the change you need to restart the save.

Supported languages are English and Russian. Translations are welcome.
 
[b][i]C[/i][i]hanges[/i][/b]:

[b][i]2.0.0 [/i][/b]
Machines added: Elite Plant Bin, Box Of Desires, Ripener, Elite Ripener, Water Ripener and Elite Water Ripener.
The Magic Wood, Boer, Aquarium and Elite mushroom stump machines now have experience gained, as well as the ability to remove the original item.
Changed barrel color for Magic Wood.
Corrected recipe for Elite mushroom stump.
Added settings to the mod configuration menu.
The ability to mine minerals and stones has been added for Boer. The option is configured through the configuration menu. By default, this option is disabled.
For Elite mushroom stump, the ability to produce truffles has been added, as well as a random quality. By default, this options are disabled.
